The reality of sponsor placement today
blocks.problem: You're paying for impressions from audiences that don't care about your brand.

blocks.solution: Editorial storytelling before the event, IRL activation the day of, recap content after. Your brand becomes part of a narrative — not a logo on a step-and-repeat.

blocks.title: If your first event doesn't hit, we make it right.
blocks.body: If your first sponsored event doesn't deliver the audience quality we promise, we'll comp your placement at the next event or refund 50%. No fine print. We only work with brands we're proud to introduce to our community.

items.q: How is this different from an influencer campaign?
items.a: Influencers rent their audience. We build a community and give you time in the room. Editorial storytelling + IRL time compounds. Instagram posts don't.

items.q: Can we bring our own team on-site?
items.a: Yes. Presenting and Season sponsors get an activation station and can staff it however works. We handle logistics.
Predominantly women 25-40, urban, wellness-engaged, mid-to-high household income, culturally-forward. Miami-heavy today, expanding to LA and NYC.
Feature tier: 3 weeks lead time. Presenting: 6 weeks. Season: quarterly planning, book one quarter ahead.
